svg.title: 2K to 4K Outpainting Task
svg.desc: Panel (a) is a schematic spatial support map, not a generated example: a centered 1920 by 1080 known RGB anchor inside a 3840 by 2160 outpainting canvas. Panel (b) abstracts the normal attention path in one LTX-2.3 transformer block. Solid arrows carry hidden features; dashed lines provide additive projection adapters. One shared OP QKV LoRA r32 and frozen base projections serve all three views. Adaptive adds A LoRA r64; Global adds G LoRA r64. Native and Adaptive are fused per local window with a Target mask, assembled, then fused with Global. A single shared O projection with OP O LoRA r32 is followed by native cross-attention and FFN with F LoRA r32. Compression/restoration, modulation, residuals, head gates, position encoding and guidance bypasses are intentionally omitted.
